title: OTHRYS OS completed-work presentation repair
goal: Make the live tablet Progress panel reflect completed missions truthfully and keep Recents bounded within the sidebar viewport.
laws: Completed Work State must never display Working.
Open Work State may display Working only when result evidence is absent.
Recents remains evidence-derived and scrollable without hiding canonical truth.
No mission, authority, routing or execution semantics change.
Use only existing status evidence from the Deck payload.

slices.title: Bind Progress badge to Work State status
